items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I had conversation with Chuck Maggione, and I asked him to do something with the band.

ctx.x: No. Has the stimulus from the album awakened additional interest from Chick or Steely Dan?

Yeah, I've had reports from Steely Dan, because of course, I haven't talked to Chick recently. But I took it upon myself to kind of help to do something for the future, and that was, I had conversation with Chuck Maggione, and I asked him to do something with the band. And I've been told by Dick LaPalm, who's in constant touch with Donald and Walter that they are truly interested in what our original premise was, which was to write some new materials that they had not done.
And my -- and adding to that little bonfire, I hope, will start -- I'm now in the throes of making arrangements to buy for my very own a -- now I have to think of the name of the instrument.
